name: wait-breathe
description: Shows one quiet nudge in the row above the prompt once a turn runs long — off by default until you turn it on.

enabled.title: Enable the breathing nudges
enabled.description: Off by default. A long turn is quiet unless you turn this on.

longTurnSeconds.title: Long-turn threshold, in seconds
longTurnSeconds.description: How long a turn runs before one quiet nudge appears in the band.
